A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same research work and contain the complete main text and Appendices A-J. Their text, equations, tables and figures support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original detector evaluations and author-attribute bias analyses on its ICNALE/LLM corpus, alongside classifier experiments and bootstrap results in the appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including detector accuracies, subgroup comparisons, statistical tests and the supplementary experiments.

M1.justification: The author-conditioned generation procedure and multi-factor WLS analysis with Type II ANOVA, LSMeans and Holm-corrected comparisons are unchanged. The algorithms and prompt construction also match.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same 5,138 ICNALE essays, 61,656 outputs from 12 LLMs, writing tasks and author groups. Appendix I retains the same HC3 and ICNALE/LLM evaluation coverage.

E2.justification: The reported comparisons retain the same ten detectors, including Binoculars, FastDetectGPT and RADAR. Appendix I also retains the same classical machine-learning classifier comparisons.

E3.justification: The off-the-shelf detector evaluation, threshold calibration to 5% false-positive rate and accuracy metric remain unchanged. Appendix I preserves its feature extraction and in-domain versus out-of-domain evaluation procedures.

E4.justification: The single-factor, matched-subset and down-sampling analyses, generated-text feature visualizations, and WLS bootstrap sensitivity analysis are unchanged, including their appendix evidence.

E5.justification: Both versions report the same significance tests and Holm corrections. Appendix J retains identical bootstrap means, standard deviations, 95% percentile confidence intervals and coverage reporting; no run-count or seed information is added.

E6.justification: The numerical results and plotted findings match throughout both versions. For example, Table 15 retains average accuracies of 0.927 for Binoculars and 0.894 for FastDetectGPT; subgroup, significance-test and bootstrap results also remain unchanged.

T1.justification: The subgroup and bias definitions, WLS objective, ANOVA formulas, variance decomposition and matched-sampling definitions are unchanged. No formal assumptions, derivations or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same corpus and statistical-framework contributions and the same claims about author attributes affecting detection, especially proficiency and language environment.

C2.justification: The interpretations of subgroup effects, confounding and generalization remain unchanged. Both versions retain the limitation that evaluation primarily covers open-source detectors and Asian English learners, with the same recommendations for broader validation.

D1.justification: Footnote 1 changes from promising a future code/data release to stating that they are released and supplying the AuthorAwareDetection repository link. This adds concrete access information; implementation details and ICNALE redistribution restrictions remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, cited works and research positioning are unchanged. References move across pages because of the added acknowledgments, without additions or removals.

P1.justification: v2 adds an Acknowledgments paragraph naming funders, thanking reviewers and identifying the corresponding author, and revises the resource-access footnote. The scientific prose and section organization otherwise remain unchanged.

P2.justification: v2 removes printed page-number footers, while the acknowledgments addition reflows the references and Appendix A. Figures and tables retain their content, numbering and structure; embedded figure images match exactly.

improvement.justification: Replacing a future-release promise with a specific repository reference improves resource discoverability and reproducibility documentation. The gain is limited because the scientific evidence is unchanged and repository contents cannot be established from the PDFs. Removed printed page numbers introduce a small navigation drawback.
